A nursery tests two seed lots, each with its own constant germination rate. In the first trial a flat of 360 Lot A seeds and 240 Lot B seeds produced 450 germinated seedlings. In the second trial a flat of 200 Lot A seeds and 400 Lot B seeds produced 410 germinated seedlings. The nursery now plants a flat of 800 seeds using only these two lots and wants at least 620 seedlings to germinate. Based on the trial rates, what is the least number of Lot A seeds the flat can contain?

Each gift basket takes up 1.5 square feet of table space and costs $14 to assemble; each candle box takes up 0.5 square feet and costs $6 to assemble. Her contract with the market requires her to display at least 4 gift baskets. What is the greatest number of candle boxes Priya can stock?

Starting at 6:00 a.m. commuters take bikes from the dock at a constant rate of 36 bikes per hour while other riders return bikes to it at a constant rate of 12 bikes per hour. Treating the bike count as changing continuously, for how many minutes is the dock balanced?

A maintenance crew must ride with a tool cart that weighs 220 kg, and each crew member has an average mass of 70 kg. If n is the number of crew members in the car, how many integer values of n keep the total load within the safe operating range?

In a survey of stay cables, the tension T in a cable is measured in newtons. A cable passes the tension specification if |T - 3800| <= 260. Separately, a cable is flagged for retesting if its tension differs from the design tension of 4000 newtons by more than 4% of that design tension. The tensions that both pass the specification and are not flagged for retesting form a single interval. What is the width, in newtons, of that interval?
